concerns.text: SC-004 requires that the computational runtime of the full analysis be measured against the GitHub Actions free‑tier limit. Task T010 records runtime in `analysis_result.json` but does not include a verification step that checks the runtime against the allowed limit, leaving the acceptance criterion untested.

Constitution Principle II mandates that every external citation be verified. The Pantheon+ citation in the spec/research is marked as unverified, yet no task in the list addresses verification of this citation, so the constitution violation remains unremedied.
